summary: City park-board page read: 14 spots, $20 with water/sewer/electric ($325 monthly), first come first served. Groups written (count 6 -> 14). Pin ~690 m off (on the east-side ballfield): move to the campground at 1st St & Railroad Ave E.
flags: PIN: stored 47.64215,-97.45471 is on the ball diamond in the east-side park by ND 18, ~690 m from the campground. The city places the campground at 1st Street and Railroad Ave E, across from the softball field: a treed lot south of that corner with RVs on grass at ~47.6427,-97.4637. Move to ~47.6427,-97.4638.
PHONE: keep (701) 543-3243 (the city's number on hattonnd.com). The park board names a board member's number for questions; not proposed.
WEBSITE: https://www.hattonnd.com/ -> https://www.hattonnd.com/park-board (the page with the campground's rates and rules).

LONG-STAY: the campground also rents monthly ($325); the park board's mobile-home trailer park ($90 a month lot rent) is a separate facility. The campground is sold nightly at $20, first come first served, and is park-board run (not private).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands (no water nearby).

SITES: the pads are on grass among trees; individual pedestals are not visible on the imagery. The city sells numbered 'spots' with full hookups, so this is a designated campground, not a lawn allowance.
